note: Tracer is a developer instrumentation module with no config UI, no schema, no permissions, no Drush and no plugin manager. Its only runtime switch is $settings['tracer_plugin'] in settings.php (default unset -> NoopTracer). It decorates core services (event_dispatcher -> TraceableEventDispatcher, HTTP kernel middleware, http_client middleware, controller resolver, Twig profiler). Because the site is shared and settings.php is edited concurrently by other agents, the evals deliberately AVOID mutating settings.php: recipe covers activation/interface/decoration; introspection reads the live service classes (tracer.tracer -> NoopTracer, event_dispatcher -> TraceableEventDispatcher); execution has the agent WRITE a TracerInterface backend class file under web/modules/custom/ (never enabled -> no orphaned module) which verify require()s and reflects/instantiates. Fixtures are namespaced trcr_* module dirs, removed on cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: The Tracer module is enabled on my Drupal site but nothing is being traced. How do I activate a real tracer backend, and what does Tracer use by default when none is configured?
evals.expected_output: Set $settings['tracer_plugin'] in settings.php to the fully-qualified class name of a TracerInterface implementation (e.g. Webprofiler's, or your own). With nothing configured, TracerFactory returns Drupal\tracer\NoopTracer, which records nothing.

evals.prompt: In the Tracer module, which service/interface do I use to record trace spans from my own code, and what are its main methods?
evals.expected_output: Inject the tracer.tracer service (Drupal\tracer\TracerInterface). Methods: start(category, name, attributes) returns a span, openSection(span), closeSection(span), stop(span), and getEvents() returns the recorded spans.

evals.prompt: What core Drupal services does the Tracer module decorate or replace so they can be traced?
evals.expected_output: It decorates event_dispatcher with a TraceableEventDispatcher, wraps the HTTP kernel with TracesMiddleware (http_middleware), adds an HttpClientMiddleware for Guzzle, replaces the controller resolver with TraceableControllerResolver, and adds a Twig profiler extension (via tracer.services.yml + TracerServiceProvider).

evals.prompt: Inspect this running Drupal site: what concrete class does the tracer.tracer service currently resolve to, and what does that tell you about whether a real tracer backend is active?
evals.expected_output: tracer.tracer resolves to Drupal\tracer\NoopTracer (get_class(\Drupal::service('tracer.tracer'))), meaning no tracer_plugin is configured in settings.php and no real backend is active - tracing is a no-op.

evals.prompt: On this running site, prove that Tracer has instrumented the event system: what class does the core event_dispatcher service resolve to while Tracer is enabled?
evals.expected_output: event_dispatcher resolves to Drupal\tracer\EventDispatcher\TraceableEventDispatcher (Tracer decorates the event_dispatcher service), verifiable via get_class(\Drupal::service('event_dispatcher')).

evals.prompt: Create a custom Tracer backend for this site. Write a PHP class file at web/modules/custom/trcr_backend/src/SpanTracer.php defining the class Drupal\trcr_backend\SpanTracer that implements Drupal\tracer\TracerInterface (all of its methods: start, openSection, closeSection, stop, getEvents). You do not need to enable a module - just create the class file on disk.
evals.expected_output: The file web/modules/custom/trcr_backend/src/SpanTracer.php exists, passes php -l, and defines Drupal\trcr_backend\SpanTracer implementing Drupal\tracer\TracerInterface (start/openSection/closeSection/stop/getEvents).

evals.prompt: Write a WORKING Tracer backend at web/modules/custom/trcr_recorder/src/RecordingTracer.php: class Drupal\trcr_recorder\RecordingTracer implementing Drupal\tracer\TracerInterface that actually records spans, so that after calling start() and then stop() on a span, getEvents() returns a non-empty array containing the recorded span. Just create the class file (no module enable needed).
evals.expected_output: web/modules/custom/trcr_recorder/src/RecordingTracer.php defines Drupal\trcr_recorder\RecordingTracer implementing TracerInterface; instantiating it, calling start() then stop(), and calling getEvents() returns an array with at least one recorded span.
